# Pronunciations of homograph senses, where matching Google's sense list to
# CMUdict does not give the right one. Written by hand.
#
# The build takes every sense of the Wikipedia Homograph Data (wordids.tsv),
# picks the CMUdict entry closest to the pronunciation given there, and then
# applies this table. Most rows are senses CMUdict does not list separately
# (it has one entry for both "implement"s), or typing slips in the source.
# Columns: word, sense, pronunciation (CMUdict notation or phones).
